description: Explicit compile expectation for every tracked .calr fixture under samples/ and tests/, read by scripts/fixture_compile_check.py (Tier 1: samples/; Tier 2: samples/ and tests/). Every fixture is listed by path exactly once; there is no pattern or catch-all. compile = must compile. reject = must fail with exactly the listed error signature; negativeKind designed means the fixture exists to fail, incidental means nothing compiles it and it is invalid Calor that the compiler rejects correctly. known-failure = a real compiler failure, kept as a failure and never counted as a pass. Error signature = sorted unique error-severity codes, with Calor1002 suffixed by its Roslyn code. Options mirror the fixture's consumer and are limited to the checker's allowlist. The checker compiles each fixture once; it performs no AST round trip.
